}}'''Estair''' is an [[Wise One apprentice|apprentice]] to the [[Wise One]] [[Aeron]].

==Appearance==
She has red hair. She is slender with serious gray eyes.

==Activities==
She is with the Wise Ones camped outside [[Cairhien]]. She is in awe of [[Rand al'Thor]] being the ''[[Car'a'carn]]''. She is part of the group that whips [[Egwene]] for lying about being [[Aes Sedai]].

It can be assumed that during the [[Last Battle]] she fights in [[Thakan'dar]] Valley along the other Wise Ones.
